content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My smart bulbs change color when my mood shifts, even without me touching the app.
Color changes can be tied to routines, scenes, or integrations. Are any schedules, sunrise/sunset rules, or presence automations enabled?
There’s a sunset scene and a “relax” routine after 9 p.m.
Those could account for warm tones. Did the shifts you noticed line up with those times or with another device’s presence status?
App logs often list which automation fired (scene name, schedule). A quick look at the history around those minutes can show the trigger source.
That entry links the change to the routine. If another time shifts without a log, noting any third-party app links may help isolate it.
I’ll check linked services if it happens off-schedule.
